reviewer: direct side-conversation review; no subagents launched

research.finding: Allocate more compute only after inexpensive screening. Keep the existing 40/160-generation stages; do not mistake this conservative two-arm screen for the Hyperband algorithm.

bottleneck.finding: Concurrent trials compete for the same CPUs as live training.
bottleneck.decision: set live CPUWeight=100, trial and health CPUWeight=10; preserve CPUs 6,7 and existing memory limits; extend trial timeouts for lower priority
bottleneck.limitation: Observational timing comparison, not a controlled benchmark. Post-change throughput has not yet been measured. Lower priority cannot guarantee zero contention.

design.finding: Cycle 0 saved identical weights in both arms; duplicate deterministic audits return the same outcome.
design.decision: deduplicate audit work within each same-scenario comparison by exact weight digest; preserve separate evidence labels and all selection gates
